from collections import Counter
path='/workspace/stxbp1_region.sam'
positions={130423404,130423405,130423406}
counts={p:Counter() for p in positions}
readcount=0
with open(path) as f:
    for line in f:
        if line.startswith('@'): continue
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(parts)<11: continue
        qname,flag,rname,pos,mapq,cigar=parts[:6]
        seq=parts[9]
        if rname"'!='"'chr9': continue
        pos=int(pos) # 1-based leftmost
        refpos=pos
        qpos=0
        ops=[]
        i=0
        while i<len(cigar):
            j=i
            while j<len(cigar) and cigar[j].isdigit(): j+=1
            n=int(cigar[i:j])
            op=cigar[j]
            ops.append((n,op))
            i=j+1
        for n,op in ops:
            if op in 'M=X':
                for k in range(n):
                    rp=refpos+k
                    if rp in positions:
                        counts[rp][seq[qpos+k]]+=1
                        readcount+=1
                refpos+=n; qpos+=n
            elif op=='I':
                qpos+=n
            elif op=='D' or op=='N':
                refpos+=n
            elif op=='S':
                qpos+=n
            else:
                # ignore others, adjust maybe
                pass
for p in sorted(positions):
    print(p, counts[p])
PY"
